experiment_metadata.title: Empirical comparison of the four PROPOSED reward formulations (F1-F4) for the BWSN-1 PPO environment
experiment_metadata.status: EVIDENCE ONLY. No formulation selected, no score/rank/tier/winner assigned, no weights tuned, no safety clamp added (STEP 9), no PPO trained. D-P6-005 remains PROPOSED.

env.determinism: EPANET's hydraulic solver is deterministic. No stochastic input is used anywhere in Phase 5; leak-node selection and leak-coefficient allocation are closed-form functions of pipe length, so no random seed is required. Recorded seed: none used.

experiment_metadata.purpose: transparent, reproducible evidence for the researcher to make and document decision D-P6-005; measurement over preference, evidence over intuition.
experiment_metadata.coverage_statement: 19 static in-bounds commands x 193 report timesteps = 3667 instants: native reference, joint PRV lower/upper edges, each PRV isolated at its lower/upper edge, both pump edges, and four mixed PRV+pump corners. This is the edges+corners+reference of the 7-D action box and is NOT exhaustive over the joint-action interior; interior/mixed-corner joint safety is a STEP-9 + STEP-12 job.
experiment_metadata.leak_instrument_status: VALIDATION instrument, NOT field-calibrated; only RELATIVE leakage response is meaningful (brief 18).
experiment_metadata.separation_of_concerns: action-space bounds (STEP 6, fixed) are NOT a safety mechanism; any state-dependent clamp is STEP 9 (unapproved) and is NOT applied in this measurement.

formulations.sign_convention: reward is a NEGATIVE cost; higher (less negative) is better
formulations.time_aggregation: per report timestep (1800 s); episode return = sum over the 193 report steps of a 96 h EPS. Reported here as per-step temporal statistics + per-config mean. No discounting applied in this measurement.
formulations.terminal_behavior: fixed-horizon EPS, no early termination in Phase 6; a STEP-9 safety termination/clamp is NOT part of this measurement.

formulations.name: safety_first_lexicographic
formulations.expression: if min_svc_p_t < 0: r_t = -c_hard - deficit_t/deficit_ref; elif min_svc_p_t < theta: r_t = -c_soft - deficit_t/deficit_ref; else: r_t = -(leak_t/leak_ref) - eps*(||da_t||^2/L2sq_max)

formulations.epsilon_handling: fixed nonzero denominators; eps effort tie-break

provisional_parameters.disclaimer: PROVISIONAL FOR COMPARISON ONLY - none selected or tuned

normalization_constants.source: LOADED verbatim from results/phase6/p6_s8_reward_scale_analysis.json (frozen, no online/running statistics, no test-set fitting).
normalization_constants.note: FIXED constants measured once (baseline reference run / this analysis) and frozen; NOT per-episode running statistics -> no train/eval leakage. deficit_ref guards against a ~0 baseline deficit by taking max(baseline mean, pooled p95).

actuator_effort_analytic.note: realised movement is 0 in every static configuration here; a boundary-to-boundary single-step move would add w_A*1.0 of cost. Whether that dominates depends on the (unchosen) weights and the realised policy trajectory - a training-time HYPOTHESIS. The effort term MUST use the COMMANDED normalised action, never realised pump speed (native STATUS resets it).

A_leakage_only_collapses_service.observation: a leak-only reward's highest-reward tested command sits at the PRV lower bound; its worst-node service pressure is reported for the researcher to judge.

B_service_only_raises_leakage.observation: a service/safety-only reward's highest-reward tested command raises leakage relative to the leak-only incentive; the two objectives pull in opposite directions (consistent with STEP 8 correlations).

C_actuator_penalty_domination.note: realised movement is 0 in all static configs; ANALYTIC only. A unit-weight max move (cost 1.0) is comparable to the entire measured leak-term range across tested commands (~0.108), so an un-tuned effort weight could dominate the leakage objective - weight choice is a D-P6-005 concern, not resolved here.

F_sparse_or_degenerate_violation_signal.observation: the <0 psi hard term is identically inactive in bounds (sparse), while the <20 psi term is active at ~every timestep INCLUDING the native baseline (2 chronically low nodes). A hard 20 psi constraint term therefore fires on the baseline itself; the smooth deficit / min-pressure terms carry the dense safety signal.

G_reward_hacking_and_degeneracy.closed_pump_realized_speed: effort/smoothness MUST be computed on the COMMANDED normalised action; realised pump speed is reset to 1.0 by STATUS-IS-OPEN or 0 when closed (G12), so penalising realised speed is gameable.
G_reward_hacking_and_degeneracy.hard_20psi_constraint_degeneracy: F2 (BIG*n_below20) and F4 (threshold 20 psi) treat the network's chronic sub-20 nodes as a constraint violation on EVERY tested command, so the leakage objective receives little/no gradient under those parameters - an ill-posed hard constraint, not a learning signal.
G_reward_hacking_and_degeneracy.lexicographic_0psi_permissiveness: F4 with a 0 psi threshold never triggers in bounds, so it reduces to pure leak minimisation and inherits the boundary-seeking-to-lower-PRV incentive while reporting 'safe'.

H_weight_penalty_sensitivity.note: see `sensitivity_results`: varying the PROVISIONAL weights shifts the incentive-argmax configuration; this is expected and is exactly why weight selection is deferred to the researcher (D-P6-005).

sensitivity_results.note: PROVISIONAL FOR COMPARISON ONLY. The incentive-argmax shifting with weights is the intended demonstration that weight/formulation selection is a researcher decision (D-P6-005), not an automatable one.

limitations: Static-command runs: realised actuator movement is 0, so the F1/F4 effort term is identically 0 here; its scale is ANALYTIC (HYPOTHESIS).
Leakage is a VALIDATION instrument, not field-calibrated; only relative response is meaningful, never an absolute leakage claim.
Coverage is edges+corners+reference of the 7-D action box; the joint interior is NOT covered - no exhaustive joint-safety claim.
Provisional weights/penalties are for side-by-side comparison only; no formulation is scored, ranked, or selected (D-P6-005 stays PROPOSED).

The <20 psi service threshold is chronically unmet by the native BWSN-1 baseline (2 nodes), so hard 20 psi constraint terms fire on the baseline itself - a formulation-design consideration, not a bug.

reproducibility_information.deterministic: EPANET deterministic; no RNG; no seed
